title: The most frequent word
summary: Words, case folding, counting and ties.
hints: Read the file character by character: letters (made lower case) go into a word buffer; any other character ends the current word.
Keep a growing array of `struct { char word[64]; int count; }`; for each word look it up (a linear search is fine) and add 1 or append a new entry.
At the end pick the entry with the highest count; on equal counts the smaller word (by `strcmp`) wins.
